name: ADMIN — KeyCRM Customer Index Incremental Sync

parameters.query:
WITH state AS (
  SELECT last_successful_sync_at
  FROM public.keycrm_sync_state
  WHERE sync_name = 'buyers_incremental'
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT last_successful_sync_at FROM state), now() - interval '1 hour') - interval '2 minutes' AS from_ts,
  now() AS to_ts;

parameters.name: filter[updated_between]
parameters.value: ={{ new Date($('Load sync window').first().json.from_ts).toISOString() + ',' + new Date($('Load sync window').first().json.to_ts).toISOString() }}

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS buyers, $2::timestamptz AS checkpoint
), source_rows AS (
    SELECT (buyer->>'buyer_id')::bigint AS buyer_id, COALESCE(buyer->>'full_name','') AS full_name,
           ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(buyer->'phones','[]'::jsonb)))::text[] AS phones,
           ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(buyer->'emails','[]'::jsonb)))::text[] AS emails,
           NULLIF(buyer->>'keycrm_updated_at','')::timestamptz AS keycrm_updated_at, input.checkpoint AS synced_at
    FROM input CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(input.buyers) AS buyer
), upserted AS (
    INSERT INTO public.keycrm_customers (buyer_id,full_name,phones,emails,keycrm_updated_at,synced_at)
    SELECT buyer_id,full_name,phones,emails,keycrm_updated_at,synced_at FROM source_rows
    ON CONFLICT (buyer_id) DO UPDATE SET full_name=EXCLUDED.full_name, phones=EXCLUDED.phones, emails=EXCLUDED.emails, keycrm_updated_at=EXCLUDED.keycrm_updated_at, synced_at=EXCLUDED.synced_at
    RETURNING buyer_id
), state_update AS (
    INSERT INTO public.keycrm_sync_state (sync_name,last_successful_sync_at,last_count,updated_at)
    SELECT 'buyers_incremental', input.checkpoint, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM upserted), now() FROM input
    ON CONFLICT (sync_name) DO UPDATE SET last_successful_sync_at=EXCLUDED.last_successful_sync_at,last_count=EXCLUDED.last_count,updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at
    RETURNING last_successful_sync_at,last_count,updated_at
) SELECT last_successful_sync_at,last_count,updated_at FROM state_update;
